top_signals.title: Fed to Soon Consider Raising Bank Asset Thresholds, Bowman Says
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said the Fed will look later this year to update its rules for fixed-dollar asset thresholds in a bid to account for inflation and economic growth. “This will preserve the policy intent at the time the threshold was implemented,” Bowman said Tuesday in remarks to a community banking research conference. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
